limits: Sampled station histories start at the first one-second check and can miss short state changes.
Reserved-empty state intervals split when owner, activity, or rider state changes. They are not whole reservation lifetimes.
Histories cover berth states and physical holds on tagged station lanes, not every hidden junction resource or mainline queue.
Primary safety checks sample once per second. Dense pilots and separate 60-second restored-copy continuations do not prove full per-tick primary safety or future demand replay.
Functional workers do not provide CPU comparisons. These seeds and rates do not establish the full operating envelope.
